escaping: detail is one physical UTF-8 line; replace literal newline/carriage-return/pipe with visible escaped forms before emitting
rules: A PASS marker is evidence routing metadata, not proof by itself; the producing test must be tied to the exact frozen source SHA.
Duplicate PASS markers for one check are allowed only when the evidence bundle retains the producing boot index/context.
A FAIL marker for a required check invalidates the current Step40 candidate until the owning Step31-39 contract is fixed and a new exact candidate is frozen.
No kernel source may emit fake-success Step40 markers solely to satisfy the harness. Markers belong to test/composition evidence, not compatibility semantics.

aggregate_checks.source: Step40 repeat_boots records plus per-boot serial/host evidence
